notes: LoRa characterization centers on the CSS link: sensitivity and link budget per SF/BW, time-on-air, channel/frequency accuracy, TX power/EIRP, duty-cycle enforcement, and RX-window timing. Conformance is established by the LoRa Alliance Certification program.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Receiver sensitivity per SF/BW
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm ~-148 dBm at SF12/125 kHz and the sensitivity ladder across SF7-SF12.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Time-on-air per SF/BW/CR
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate symbol time Tsym = 2^SF/BW and frame airtime.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Frequency / channel accuracy
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm carrier and channel plan against the regional band.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: TX power / EIRP
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm regional power limit (e.g. +14 dBm EU868).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: RX-window timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm RX1/RX2 open at RECEIVE_DELAY1 / RECEIVE_DELAY2.
